events.verdict: Mashack (MEM) legally contests Podziemski's (GSW) shot attempt near the rim.
Santos (GSW) makes contact to Spencer's (MEM) elbow, affecting his jump shot attempt.

Replay review of the out of bounds called on GSW pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Mashack (MEM) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds and GSW is awarded possession.
Although Mashack (MEM) gets his hand on the ball, he reaches in with his other hand and makes illegal contact to Horford's (GSW) head/face.
Mashack (MEM) gets his hand firmly on the ball as he defends Horford (GSW) and a held ball is whistled.
Spencer (MEM) legally contests Melton's (GSW) jump shot attempt.
Mashack (MEM) establishes himself in Santos' (GSW) path prior to the contact.
Podziemski (GSW) is moving alongside Jackson's (MEM) path and absorbs the contact that occurs during the drive.
Small's (MEM) shot attempt fails to make contact with the rim and the shot clock expires.
Mashack (MEM) gets his hand firmly on the ball during Melton's (GSW) drive to the basket and a held ball is whistled.
Jackson (MEM) legally contests Horford's (GSW) shot attempt at the rim.
Horford (GSW) makes contact with the ball after it exits the imaginary cylinder above the rim.
Wells (MEM) briefly gets his hand on the ball, which causes Horford (GSW) to lose his balance and fall to the floor. Horford remains in bounds and there is no traveling violation on the play.
Jackson (MEM) lowers his arm and makes contact to the ball during Santos's (GSW) layup attempt.
Small (MEM) stops his drive to the basket and Santos (GSW) loses his balance on his own.
Santos (GSW) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact that occurs during Mashack's (MEM) layup attempt. Moody (GSW) legally contests the shot attempt, as well.
Podziemski (GSW) legally contests and Spencer (MEM) loses control of the ball on his own.
